## About me

I'm a second-year PhD student trying to figure out the genetics of fin shape in
sticklebacks. I came to RaukR to finally stop emailing myself `analysis_final_v3_REAL.R`.

## A fun fact

I once spent two days debugging a script before realising I had two objects called
`data` and `Data`. 🙃

## My favourite (or most cursed) plot

A volcano plot so red it looked like a crime scene. Reviewers loved it.
